مَقِرٌ Bitter; (S, A, Msb, K;) as also ↓ مَقْرٌ (TA) and ↓ مُمْقِرٌ (S, A, K) and ↓ يَمْقُورٌ : (Sgh, K:) or sour; acid; as also ↓ مُمْقِرٌ : (K:) which last also signifies intensely sour or acid; (AZ, Aboo-Málik, S; *) applied to milk: (the same, and K:) or sour, or acid, milk. (Msb.) ―
-b2- Aloes; syn. صَبِرٌ: (As, S, A, Msb, K:) as also ↓ مَقْرٌ : (S:) or a certain thing resembling it: (IKt, Msb, K:) or poison: as also ↓ مَقْرٌ ; (K;) which is said by some to be a form used by poetic license: (TA:) or, accord. to AA, a certain bitter kind of tree: and accord. to AHn, a certain plant, which grows in leaves without branches. (TA.) [See صَقِرٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
